fusions.name: Headlong Shove
fusions.desc: A headlong blow that deals 15 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Loosened Scree
fusions.desc: Dislodges a boulder that deals 36 rock damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Dug-In Hooves
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Cliffside Poise
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. Your dodge chance rises by 6%.
